# plotwork_organization_icon (Resource)

One of an organisation's custom icons, which its diagrams draw with `icon=org:<name>` on the hosted service. Give the SVG as text in `svg` (from `file()`, an `aws_s3_object` data source, or a `data "http"` download), or as an https address in `source_url` that the provider downloads.

Plotwork rewrites the SVG from an allowlist and keeps that copy, so the provider tracks the file it sent by `content_sha256`, worked out during plan. A change to the file, or to what `source_url` serves, uploads it again.

Needs the owner's plan to include custom icons (Pro or above), and the owner or an admin, or an organisation key with the `design:write` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# From a file in this module.
resource "plotwork_organization_icon" "payments" {
  organization = "acme"
  name         = "payments-api"
  svg          = file("${path.module}/icons/payments-api.svg")
  aliases      = ["payments service"]
}

# Every SVG in a folder, one icon each, named after the file.
resource "plotwork_organization_icon" "team" {
  for_each = fileset("${path.module}/icons/team", "*.svg")

  organization = "acme"
  name         = trimsuffix(each.value, ".svg")
  svg          = file("${path.module}/icons/team/${each.value}")
}

# From an S3 object. The aws provider fills body only for text types such
# as application/xml and text/*, not image/svg+xml: store the SVG as
# application/xml, or give source_url a pre-signed address instead.
data "aws_s3_object" "ledger" {
  bucket = "acme-design"
  key    = "icons/ledger.svg"
}

resource "plotwork_organization_icon" "ledger" {
  organization = "acme"
  name         = "ledger"
  svg          = data.aws_s3_object.ledger.body
}

# From Azure Blob Storage. azurerm_storage_blob does not read a blob's
# contents, so download it with a read-only SAS address.
data "http" "queue" {
  url = "https://acmedesign.blob.core.windows.net/icons/queue.svg?${var.icons_sas}"
}

resource "plotwork_organization_icon" "queue" {
  organization = "acme"
  name         = "queue"
  svg          = data.http.queue.response_body
}

# From a CDN: the provider downloads the address during every plan, so a
# new file there is a planned change.
resource "plotwork_organization_icon" "gateway" {
  organization = "acme"
  name         = "gateway"
  source_url   = "https://cdn.acme.example/icons/gateway.svg"
}

# A diagram draws it with icon=org:payments-api.
output "payments_icon" {
  value = plotwork_organization_icon.payments.ref
}

variable "icons_sas" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name after `org:`, such as `payments-api`: lower-case words joined by hyphens, at most 48 characters. Changing it replaces the icon.

### Optional

- `aliases` (List of String) Other names search and automatic icon matching find the icon by, such as `payments service`. At most 10.
- `organization` (String) The slug or id of the organisation. Defaults to the provider's `organization` (or `PLOTWORK_ORG`). Changing it, or the provider's value when this is left out, replaces the resource in the new organisation.
- `source_url` (String, Sensitive) An https address that serves the SVG, such as a CDN or a pre-signed object URL. The provider downloads it during every plan (30 s timeout, at most 32 KB, `image/svg+xml` or an untyped body that is an SVG), so a new file there is a planned change. Sensitive, because a signed address holds a credential. Set this or `svg`.
- `svg` (String) The SVG file's text, at most 32 KB, such as `file("${path.module}/icons/payments-api.svg")` or an `aws_s3_object` data source's `body` (which the aws provider fills only for a text type such as `application/xml`). Set this or `source_url`.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) The size of the stored, rewritten file.
- `content_sha256` (String) The hex SHA-256 of the file the provider sent. Empty after an import, or when the icon was replaced outside Terraform: the next apply uploads the file again.
- `height` (Number) The icon's height, from its view box.
- `id` (String) `<organisation>/<name>`.
- `media_type` (String) The stored file's type: `image/svg+xml`.
- `ref` (String) What a diagram writes to draw the icon: `org:<name>`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the icon was last saved, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.
- `width` (Number) The icon's width, from its view box.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organisation's icon, as <organisation>/<name>. Plotwork keeps a checked
# copy, not the file, so the next apply uploads the configured file once.
terraform import plotwork_organization_icon.payments acme/payments-api
```
